summary: Tested BI layer + Menu Recipe mapping + Staff hourly_rate. Backend all 7 pytest cases passed (BI overview shape/KPIs, auth gating, date+location filters, menu-cost, PUT recipe persists + reflects in BI, staff hourly_rate CRUD). Frontend BI dashboard renders correctly with all 4 KPI cards, date preset, location filter, menu cost toggle, and recipe editor in Admin Menu modal. Staff page hourly-rate column visibility could not be confirmed via inner_text and needs spot-check.

ui_bugs.issue: Body inner_text did not include '£/hr' or 'Hourly Rate' on /admin/staff page after load. Could be staff list empty, async render, or the column/field is missing. Worth manual verification.

issues: With 'Last 7 days' preset (default for new period state), the per-location table shows 'No sales entries' because the existing seed daily_sales rows are older than 7 days. Consider defaulting preset to 30 or 90 days, or showing an empty-state hint pointing user to widen range.

action_items: Verify /admin/staff page actually shows 'Hourly Rate (£)' field in add/edit drawer and '£/hr' column in the staff table (test only inspected inner_text snapshot).

Consider seeding at least one daily_sales row inside the last 7 days OR shipping the BI default preset as '30 days' to avoid empty-state on first view (already coded as '30' in state but applyPreset('7') was clicked in test).
Cloudflare bot-challenge intermittently blocks the preview URL after rapid navigations during automated testing (does not affect end-users).
critical_code_review_comments: bi.py: synchronous pymongo calls inside async FastAPI handlers (find/find_one). Functional but not strictly async — acceptable but flag for future refactor.

bi.py uses case-insensitive lowercase staff name match between staff_members.name and daily_sales.staff_hours[].name. If name spellings differ (e.g., 'John S.' vs 'John Smith'), labour cost will be 0. Consider using staff_id linkage in DailySales entries longer term.
menu cost endpoint includes location_id filter but does not enforce a date range; that's fine since recipes are time-invariant.
/admin/bi default preset id state is '30' but startDate/endDate are initialised via daysAgoISO(29). They stay in sync, good.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_BIStaff via /api/admin/staff (cleaned up). Added recipe lines to one Timperley menu item with ingredient names prefixed TEST_ for traceability — recipe persists across runs but lines are clearly tagged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BI tests cover happy paths and recipe-cost reflection. The TestRecipePersistence test mutates a real menu item's recipe (does not roll back). Staff page UI (hourly_rate column visibility) and post-logout SuperAdminRoute redirect could not be visually verified due to Cloudflare bot-challenge during the test run. Code inspection confirms SuperAdminRoute returns <Navigate to='/admin' replace/> when user.role !== 'super_admin'.
